_notes: NSE trading holidays used by data/expiry_calendar.py. An expiry that falls on a segment_closed holiday moves to the previous trading day.
Forward-looking only (on/after 2026-10-19). Historical expiries (and therefore every backtest ending 2026-08-29) are deliberately unaffected.
Add each new exchange holiday list here every year and re-verify against the NSE holiday circular/API.
verified=true means confirmed against the official NSE holiday master (source field). verified=false means not confirmed; the entry is still applied.
Muhurat sessions are informational only (muhurat_session=true, segment_closed=false) and do not shift expiries.

holidays.name: Dussehra
holidays.notes: Tuesday. Weekly/monthly Tuesday expiry moves to Monday 2026-10-19.

holidays.name: Diwali Laxmi Pujan (Muhurat trading)
